note: OpenAPI: a #[cfg(test)] / #[cfg(not(test))] twin pair of one route documents the production route in every build (cargo build, cargo test, rust-analyzer); the cfg(test) choice no longer reads the compiler argv. Garde integer bounds past 2^53 accept exactly the documented bound. Cron: a child module importing a parent's cron alias by name (use super::job;) or a parent's bare cron (use super::cron;) follows the parent's import. A route whose arguments the strict validators reject is no longer documented by the slow path. Merge: a path through an extern crate names that crate's export (a renamed dependency is the crate its rlib names). Workspace-root lookup fallback tests no longer depend on ancestors of the temp directory.
